title: OEIS Learn Phase 2 CLI Interface Contract
description: Expanded command-line contract for Phase 2 synthesis bootstrapping, progressive testing, and RL exploration

generate-sft.description: Generate synthetic forward-execution demonstration dataset of sequence-program pairs.

--output-path.description: Output path for the generated synthetic dataset

--num-samples.description: Number of synthetic program-sequence pairs to generate

warmup-sft.description: Execute Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) pretraining on synthetic demonstrations.

--dataset-path.description: Path to synthetic demonstration JSON file

--output-checkpoint.description: Destination path for the warmed-up model checkpoint

test-progressive.description: Run the 5-tier progressive validation hierarchy (Tiers 0 through 3) before full training.

--max-tier.description: Highest tier to execute in pre-flight suite

--output-report.description: Path to write JSON validation results

train.description: Train the policy using S-GRPO, trajectory injection, and cosine-decayed reward shaping.

--sft-checkpoint.description: Optional warmed-up SFT checkpoint to initialize policy

--tier.description: Hardware tier (1 = local workstation, 2 = cluster scale-up)

synthesize.description: Synthesize a WebAssembly algorithm for a target sequence with extrapolation testing.

--extrapolate.description: Number of future terms to verify

discover.description: Run the self-supervised manifold discovery and PSLQ theorem verification pipeline.

--checkpoint.description: Path to model checkpoint with VICReg embeddings

--max-candidates.description: Maximum number of candidate relations to verify

--precision-digits.description: Decimal precision digits for mpmath sampling
